verdict.rationale: One hands-on community report confirms a Snowflake trial that ran real workloads: the user consumed 9 credits and 40GB of storage, about $19.60 worth of resources. The rest of the story is unevidenced. The pricing page only describes a paid 'Standard' entry-level edition, not a free tier. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the trial (length, credit allowance), evidence that sign-up needs no credit card, evidence that no sales call is required, and any permanent free tier.
